facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

assets.label: hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel
assets.service: diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of TK-4211 during a breakdown response

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-4211 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on TK-4211 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on TK-4211 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-4211 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 22 July 2025 an incident occurred on TK-4211 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
